title: Returns for fashion, footwear and accessories
text: Fashion, footwear and accessories bought on Tamarind Lane can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Club Elite members get 15 days. The item must be unused and unwashed, with the original brand tags and the green Tamarind Lane security tag still attached; returns without the security tag are rejected at the doorstep quality check. Raise the request from My Orders in the app or on the website. The Return button disappears at 11:59 pm on the last day of the window. Non-returnable items: innerwear, lingerie, swimwear, socks, beauty and personal care, fragrances, customised or tailored items, and gold or silver jewellery and coins. These can be reported only if they arrive damaged or wrong, under the damaged items process. Final Sale items: everything bought in the End of Season Sale, and any product marked Final Sale on its page, cannot be returned for a refund. Final Sale items can be exchanged for a different size within 10 days of delivery, subject to stock, using the size exchange process. Reverse pickup fee: a pickup fee of ₹99 per return request is deducted from the refund. Several items picked up in the same request attract the fee only once. The fee is waived for Club Plus and Club Elite members, and when the item is damaged, defective or not what you ordered. Pickups are attempted up to 2 times. If both attempts fail, you can self-ship the parcel to our returns centre in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, and we reimburse courier costs up to ₹150 as Kosh Wallet refund balance after the parcel arrives. Refunds are initiated after the doorstep quality check; see Refund timelines by payment method for when the money reaches you.

title: Returns and replacements for electronics and gadgets
text: Electronics and gadgets bought on Tamarind Lane, including mobiles, laptops, tablets, smartwatches, headphones, speakers, cameras and small kitchen appliances such as mixers and air fryers, are not returnable for a refund. They are eligible for replacement only within 3 days of delivery, and only if the item is dead on arrival, physically damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered. Change-of-mind returns are not accepted for electronics. For mobiles, laptops and tablets, a technician from the brand or from our service partner must verify the defect before a replacement is approved. The visit is normally scheduled within 48 hours of your request. Mixers and other small appliances are verified from photos and a short video. The replacement is the identical model and colour. If it is out of stock, we refund the full amount to the original payment method instead. Return the item with its box, charger, cables, manuals and any free gifts that came with it. Before pickup, remove your Google or Apple account from phones, tablets and laptops, turn off the screen lock, and take out any SIM or memory card. A device still linked to your account cannot be accepted and the pickup will be cancelled. Accessories priced under ₹1,000, such as chargers, cables, phone cases and screen guards, are treated differently: they can be returned for a refund within 7 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Damage you notice on opening must be reported within 48 hours under the damaged items process, which needs an unboxing video for electronics. After 3 days, faults are handled under the manufacturer's warranty at the brand's service centre.

title: Refund timelines by payment method
text: Refunds are initiated once a returned item passes quality check. For most fashion items the check happens at your doorstep during pickup, so the refund is initiated the same day. Electronics, large items and self-shipped returns are checked at our warehouse within 2 working days of arrival. Cancelled orders are refunded as soon as the cancellation is confirmed. After a refund is initiated, it reaches you as follows. Kosh Wallet: within 2 hours. UPI: within 2 working days. Net banking and debit cards: 5 to 7 working days. Credit cards: 7 to 10 working days. The refund may show as a separate credit on your statement rather than reversing the original charge. EMI orders: the full amount is refunded to the card and your bank then closes the EMI plan. Any processing fee charged by the bank is not refunded. Gift card payments: credited back to the same gift card, which keeps its original expiry date. Kosh PayLater: the amount is adjusted against your PayLater bill within 1 working day. Cash on delivery orders: COD refunds are credited only to Kosh Wallet as refund balance, within 2 hours of the refund being initiated. We cannot transfer COD refunds to a bank account or UPI ID, and we do not issue cash refunds. Refund balance never expires and can be used on any future order. If your bank has not shown the money after the timeline above, ask our support team for the bank reference number (ARN for cards, RRN for UPI) so your bank can trace it. Working days exclude Sundays and bank holidays.

title: Cash on delivery policy (effective 1 March 2024)
text: This policy applies to orders placed from 1 March 2024. Cash on delivery (COD) is available on orders up to ₹25,000 at serviceable pincodes. A COD fee of ₹39 per order is added at checkout; it is not charged per item. The fee is waived for Club Plus members. COD is not available for gift cards, gold and silver coins, or Swift same-day orders. Pay the delivery agent in cash. Please keep the exact amount ready, as agents may not carry change. Card-on-delivery machines are available in Mumbai, Delhi NCR and Bengaluru only. If an order is refused at the doorstep, the COD fee is not charged. If 3 COD orders are refused at the doorstep within 90 days, COD is disabled on the account for 3 months. Refunds for COD orders are sent to your bank account by NEFT within 10 working days of the return being approved, after you add your bank account details under My Account. Until the details are added, the refund is held. Tamarind Lane may withdraw COD for specific products or pincodes at any time, for example during sale events or where courier partners report a high rate of refusals.

title: Cash on delivery policy (effective 1 August 2026), replaces the 1 March 2024 version
text: This policy replaces the Cash on delivery policy effective 1 March 2024 and applies to all orders placed from 1 August 2026. Cash on delivery (COD) is available on orders up to ₹10,000 at serviceable pincodes. A COD fee of ₹49 per order is added at checkout; it is charged once per order, not per item. The fee is waived for Club Plus and Club Elite members. COD is not available for gift cards, gold and silver coins, Swift same-day orders, or orders paid partly with Kosh Cash. At the door you can pay in cash or by scanning the UPI QR code shown on the delivery agent's device. Card-on-delivery has been discontinued. Please keep the exact amount ready if paying cash. The COD fee is refunded only if the entire order is returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong. It is not refunded for change-of-mind returns. If you refuse 2 COD orders at the doorstep within 90 days, COD is disabled on your account for 6 months. Prepaid payment options remain available. Refunds for COD orders are credited only to Kosh Wallet as refund balance; bank transfer by NEFT is no longer offered. See Refund timelines by payment method.

title: Delivery speeds, cutoffs and charges by pincode
text: Enter your 6-digit pincode on any product page to see whether we deliver there and the expected delivery date. A pincode is serviceable only if one of our courier partners covers it for that product; large appliances and furniture have fewer serviceable pincodes than fashion. Swift same-day delivery: available for products tagged Swift in metro pincodes of Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Ahmedabad and Kolkata. Order by 11 am and it is delivered by 10 pm the same day. Orders placed after 11 am are delivered the next day. Same-day delivery costs ₹99 per order and is free for Club Elite members. Next-day delivery: in the same metro pincodes, orders placed by 9 pm are delivered the next day at no extra charge. Standard delivery: 3 to 6 working days for other serviceable pincodes in India. Remote regions: pincodes in the north-eastern states (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura), Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep take 7 to 12 working days. Large appliances and furniture are not delivered to these regions. Delivery charges: ₹79 on orders below ₹699, and free on orders of ₹699 or more. Club Plus and Club Elite members get free standard delivery on every order. Deliveries are attempted between 9 am and 9 pm, Monday to Sunday. There are no deliveries on 26 January, 15 August and 2 October. If you are unavailable, the courier tries 2 more times on the following days before the order is returned to us.

title: Club Plus membership
text: Club Plus is our entry membership. It costs ₹499 per year, charged upfront, and renews automatically on the same date each year unless you turn off auto-renew in My Account at least 1 day before the renewal date. Club Plus benefits: free standard delivery on every order, with no minimum order value; no COD fee on cash on delivery orders; free reverse pickup on returns, so the ₹99 pickup fee is not deducted; early access to sales 24 hours before they open to everyone; and 5% back as Kosh Cash on fashion orders, up to ₹200 per month. Price drop protection for 3 days: if the price of an item you bought drops on Tamarind Lane within 3 days of your order date, we credit the difference as Kosh Cash. Club Plus does not include free Swift same-day delivery, which costs ₹99 per order, or the extended 15-day return window, which is only for Club Elite. Cancelling: you can cancel Club Plus within 7 days of joining for a full refund if you have not used any benefit. After 7 days, or once a benefit has been used, the fee is not refunded, but benefits continue until the end of the membership year. Club Plus is linked to one account and one mobile number and cannot be shared or transferred. You can upgrade to Club Elite at any time from My Account.

title: Club Elite membership
text: Club Elite is our top membership tier. It costs ₹1,499 per year, charged upfront, and renews automatically on the same date each year unless you turn off auto-renew in My Account at least 1 day before the renewal date. Club Elite includes everything in Club Plus, and adds: free Swift same-day delivery in eligible metro pincodes (normally ₹99 per order); an extended return window of 15 days for fashion, footwear and accessories, instead of 10 days; early access to sales 48 hours before they open to everyone; 7% back as Kosh Cash on fashion orders, up to ₹500 per month; a dedicated Elite support line that answers 24 hours a day; and 2 free alterations per month on eligible ethnic wear, booked through the app. Price drop protection for 7 days: if the price of an item you bought drops on Tamarind Lane within 7 days of your order date, we credit the difference as Kosh Cash. Upgrading from Club Plus: you pay the difference for the remaining months, rounded to the nearest rupee, and your renewal date stays the same. Cancelling: you can cancel Club Elite within 7 days of joining for a full refund if you have not used any benefit. After that the fee is not refunded, but benefits continue until the end of the membership year. Club Elite is linked to one account and one mobile number and cannot be shared or transferred.

title: Cancelling an order
text: You can cancel an order free of charge while its status is Ordered or Packed, from My Orders in the app or on the website. Once the status changes to Shipped, the order has been handed to the courier and it can no longer be cancelled in the app or by our support team. If you no longer want a shipped order, you can refuse the package when the delivery agent arrives. For prepaid orders, the refund is initiated once the package is back at our warehouse, which can take up to 10 working days after you refuse it, and then follows the normal refund timelines. For cash on delivery orders nothing is charged, but refusals count towards the COD refusal limit. Swift same-day orders can be cancelled only within 15 minutes of placing the order, because they are packed immediately. Customised and tailored items cannot be cancelled once production starts, which is 24 hours after the order is placed. Multi-item orders: you can cancel individual items before they are shipped. If the remaining order value drops below ₹699, the ₹79 delivery charge is added back and deducted from your refund, unless you are a Club Plus or Club Elite member. Coupons: if you cancel an item that a coupon depended on, the coupon discount is recalculated on the remaining items. A cancelled coupon is returned to your account only if it has not expired. Orders are sometimes cancelled by us when a seller cannot fulfil them; in that case any prepaid amount is refunded in full and you receive an SMS and email.

title: Size exchanges
text: Size exchanges are available on fashion and footwear, including Final Sale items, within the return window: 10 days of delivery, or 15 days for Club Elite members (Final Sale items: 10 days for everyone). An exchange swaps your item for a different size of the same product in the same colour. To change colour or product, return the item and place a new order. Exchanges are free, and the ₹99 reverse pickup fee is not deducted on exchanges. The pickup of your original item and the delivery of the new size happen in the same visit, normally within 3 to 5 working days of your request. The delivery agent checks the tags and condition of your original item at the door before handing over the new one. Each item can be exchanged once. The replacement size cannot be exchanged again, but it can be returned for a refund within 10 days of its delivery, unless it was a Final Sale item. If the size you want is out of stock, the exchange button is not shown. You can join the size alert list or return the item instead; Final Sale items cannot be returned, so they can only wait for stock or be kept. Exchanges are not available for electronics, beauty, innerwear, or items bought with a no-cost EMI offer. Sizes of the same product are sold at the same price, so if the price has changed since your order you are not charged or refunded the difference.

title: Damaged, defective, wrong or missing items
text: If an item arrives damaged, defective, wrong or with something missing, report it within 48 hours of delivery from My Orders, then Help, then Report an issue. Reports made after 48 hours are not accepted under this process: fashion items then follow the normal return rules, and electronics are handled under the manufacturer's warranty. What we need: clear photos of the item, the product label or serial number, and the outer package showing the shipping label. For electronics, and for any order above ₹5,000, we also need an unboxing video, recorded in one continuous take starting with the sealed package and its shipping label clearly visible, without cuts or edits. Claims without a valid unboxing video for these orders are rejected. Missing items: we compare the package weight recorded at dispatch with the courier's delivery weight. Keep all packaging until the claim is closed. Wrong items: we arrange a free pickup and send the correct item if it is in stock, or refund you if it is not. Damaged or defective items: we arrange a free pickup and offer a replacement or a refund. The ₹99 reverse pickup fee is never charged on these claims, and the COD fee is refunded if the entire order was affected. Glass, ceramic and other fragile items: we recommend opening them in front of the delivery agent. You may refuse a visibly damaged package at the door; refusing it does not count towards the COD refusal limit. Decisions are usually made within 2 working days of receiving complete photos and video.

title: Kosh Wallet, Kosh Cash and gift cards
text: Kosh Wallet holds two kinds of balance, shown separately in the app. Refund balance: money from refunds to Kosh Wallet, including all refunds on cash on delivery orders and courier reimbursements. Refund balance never expires, can pay for up to 100% of any order, and can be combined with any payment method. It cannot be withdrawn to a bank account. Kosh Cash: promotional money from cashback, membership rewards, price drop protection and referrals. Kosh Cash expires 30 days after it is credited. It can pay for up to 10% of an order's value, with a maximum of ₹500 per order, and cannot be used on gift cards, gold and silver coins, or cash on delivery orders. Kosh Cash used on an order that is later returned is credited back with its original expiry date; if that date has passed, it is not restored. Gift cards: Tamarind Lane gift cards are sold in values from ₹500 to ₹10,000 and are valid for 1 year from the date of issue. Add a gift card to your account using its 16-digit card number and 6-digit PIN; the balance then appears in Kosh Wallet as gift card balance and keeps its original expiry date. A gift card cannot be used to buy another gift card or gold and silver coins, and it cannot be reloaded or exchanged for cash. Holding more than ₹10,000 in total gift card balance requires PAN verification. At checkout, the balance that expires soonest is always used first.

title: No-cost EMI, card EMI and Kosh PayLater
text: No-cost EMI: available on orders of ₹3,000 or more with credit cards from select partner banks, for tenures of 3 or 6 months. The bank charges interest, and we give you an equal upfront discount, so the total of your instalments equals the product price. The bank may also charge a processing fee of up to ₹199 plus GST, and GST on the interest component; neither is covered by the discount, and the processing fee is not refunded if you cancel or return the order. Standard EMI: tenures of 3 to 24 months on credit cards for orders of ₹2,500 or more, at the interest rate set by your bank. Debit card EMI: orders of ₹5,000 or more, for customers pre-approved by their bank. Check eligibility at checkout with your bank-registered mobile number. If you return an EMI order, we refund the full amount to your card and your bank closes the EMI plan; interest already billed is adjusted by the bank under its own rules. Kosh PayLater: a short-term credit line from our lending partner, with a limit between ₹2,000 and ₹20,000 offered after a soft credit check. Everything you buy with PayLater in a calendar month is billed together, and the full bill is due by the 5th of the next month. There is no interest if you pay by the due date. A late fee of ₹150 is charged if the bill is unpaid after the due date, and PayLater is paused until the bill is cleared. Repeated late payments are reported to credit bureaus by the lending partner. PayLater cannot be used to buy gift cards or gold and silver coins.

title: Warranty, refurbished products and customer support
text: Manufacturer's warranty: most electronics and appliances sold on Tamarind Lane carry the brand's warranty, with the period shown on the product page. Claims are made directly at the brand's authorised service centre or through the brand's helpline using your invoice, which you can download from My Orders at any time. Tamarind Lane is not a service centre and cannot repair items under brand warranty, but our support team can share service centre details. Assured Refurbished: phones, laptops and tablets sold under the Assured Refurbished label have been tested and graded by our refurbishment partner. They carry a 6-month seller warranty from Tamarind Lane, not the brand's warranty. To claim, raise a request from My Orders; we pick up the device and repair or replace it within 15 working days of pickup. If it cannot be repaired or replaced, we refund the purchase price. The seller warranty does not cover physical or liquid damage, and covers the battery only if its capacity falls below 80% of the original. Customer support: chat in the app is available 24 hours a day, every day. Phone support runs from 8 am to 10 pm, every day including Sundays and public holidays. Club Elite members have a dedicated Elite support line that answers 24 hours a day. Email replies are sent within 48 hours. When you call, keep your order ID ready. For security, we will never ask for your card PIN, CVV or OTP over the phone. The only code you should share is the delivery OTP, in person, with the delivery agent at handover.
